background: Investec plc is the UK-listed half of the dual-listed Anglo-South African Investec group, a specialist bank and wealth manager funded by UK deposits and lending to mid-sized companies, professionals and high-net-worth clients.
synthesis: Only Moody's rates the group among the three agencies, at A3 with a positive outlook, after an upgrade to A3 on 14 Apr 2026, so the direction is up. As a holding company that grade sits above what such entities usually carry. The site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is no peer comparison to make. The flagged news is the positive outlook on 25 Aug 2026 and a board change on 20 Aug 2026. A single-rated name with an improving trend and no published ratios here.
